title: Work-mode state.md metadata parsing for Mode and Active Task with fail-open
statement: parseStepState is extended to read top-of-file state.md metadata keys Mode (one of sdd, vibe, wait) and Active Task (the current task name, present only when Mode is vibe) in the same single parse pass; when state.md is absent, unparseable, or the Mode line is malformed the parser yields Mode=wait as a fail-open default instead of throwing.
ac: parseStepState returns Mode equal to one of sdd, vibe, wait read from the state.md metadata block.
parseStepState returns Active Task as the task name when Mode is vibe and omits it otherwise.
A missing or unparseable state.md yields Mode=wait without throwing.
A Mode value outside sdd, vibe, wait is treated as wait and flagged.
depends_on_titles: state.md loader and parseStepState parser

title: Work mode model with get and set and fail-open default
statement: A work-mode core provides getWorkMode and setWorkMode over state.md, where Mode is one of sdd, vibe, wait and Active Task names the current vibe task; getWorkMode returns wait when state.md is absent or invalid (fail-open), and setWorkMode persists Mode and, for vibe, Active Task into the state.md metadata block.
ac: getWorkMode returns the persisted Mode and, for vibe, the Active Task.
getWorkMode returns wait when state.md is absent or invalid.
setWorkMode persists Mode into the state.md metadata block.
setWorkMode to vibe persists the Active Task name alongside Mode.
depends_on_titles: Work-mode state.md metadata parsing for Mode and Active Task with fail-open

title: speckiwi init hook-installer orchestration with scaffold minimal state and clobber and enterprise detection
statement: initProject is extended to scaffold the docs/.kiwi tree (hooks and trace directories), always create a minimal state.md, and orchestrate idempotent installation of the Claude, Codex, and git hooks, detecting and warning on an existing git pre-commit, core.hooksPath, husky, or lefthook (clobber) and on Codex allow_managed_hooks_only or Claude managed-settings.json (enterprise suppression) rather than overwriting silently.
ac: speckiwi init creates docs/.kiwi/hooks and docs/.kiwi/trace when absent.
speckiwi init creates a minimal state.md when absent and leaves an existing one unchanged.
speckiwi init detects an existing git pre-commit, core.hooksPath, husky, or lefthook and warns instead of overwriting.
speckiwi init detects Codex allow_managed_hooks_only or Claude managed-settings.json and warns that installed hooks may be ignored.
Re-running speckiwi init does not duplicate any installed hook entry.
depends_on_titles: Work mode model with get and set and fail-open default

title: Claude settings.json key-preserving JSON merger
statement: A settings.json merger reads .claude/settings.json with JSONC-aware parsing, merges a PostToolUse hook entry matching Edit, Write, MultiEdit, NotebookEdit into hooks while preserving all other keys, dedups the matcher array, writes UTF-8 without a BOM, takes a backup, and uses a sentinel marker so re-running is idempotent.
ac: Merging into an existing settings.json preserves all unrelated keys and hooks.
The merged PostToolUse entry matches Edit, Write, MultiEdit, NotebookEdit and points at the trace hook.
The file is written UTF-8 without a BOM and a backup of the prior file is taken.
A second merge is a no-op via the sentinel marker and does not duplicate the entry.
depends_on_titles: speckiwi init hook-installer orchestration with scaffold minimal state and clobber and enterprise detection

title: Codex hooks.json writer with version gate and trust-review guidance
statement: The installer writes a dedicated .codex/hooks.json registering a PostToolUse command hook matching apply_patch, Edit, Write with a commandWindows override, detects the installed Codex version via codex version and refuses or warns when below the apply_patch hook floor, avoids inline config.toml hooks, and instructs the user to trust the repo and run the hooks command once because Codex skips non-managed hooks until trusted.
ac: The installer writes .codex/hooks.json with a PostToolUse command hook matching apply_patch, Edit, Write and a commandWindows override.
The installer does not write inline hooks into config.toml.
The installer detects the Codex version and warns or refuses when below the apply_patch hook floor.
The installer prints guidance to trust the repo and run the hooks command once for the hook to activate.
depends_on_titles: speckiwi init hook-installer orchestration with scaffold minimal state and clobber and enterprise detection

title: trace.mjs per-edit hook script mode-aware with per-writer shard and fail-open
statement: The installed docs/.kiwi/hooks/trace.mjs reads the hook payload on stdin, reads work mode from state.md, and only when Mode is vibe appends one JSONL record per edit to docs/.kiwi/trace/ActiveTask/trace.sessionId.jsonl, branching on tool_name to read the Claude tool_input file path or to parse the Codex apply_patch patch body for changed paths, treating any read or parse failure or non-vibe mode as a safe no-op that never blocks the edit.
ac: trace.mjs appends a record only when state.md Mode is vibe.
trace.mjs writes to a per-session shard trace.sessionId.jsonl under the Active Task directory.
trace.mjs reads file paths from the Claude tool_input file path and from the Codex apply_patch patch body.
trace.mjs treats a missing or unparseable state.md or non-vibe mode as a no-op and never blocks the edit.
depends_on_titles: Work mode model with get and set and fail-open default

title: pre-commit.mjs local best-effort gate for unsynthesized vibe trace
statement: The installed docs/.kiwi/hooks/pre-commit.mjs, invoked from .git/hooks/pre-commit, exits non-zero to block a commit when state.md Mode is vibe and an Active Task is set but no corresponding step directory exists (unsynthesized), printing guidance to run the synthesis skill, and exits zero otherwise; it is documented as a best-effort local gate that can be bypassed.
ac: pre-commit.mjs exits non-zero when Mode is vibe and Active Task is set with no matching step directory.
pre-commit.mjs exits zero once the matching step directory exists.
pre-commit.mjs prints guidance to run the synthesis skill on block.
depends_on_titles: Work mode model with get and set and fail-open default

title: vibe-to-SRS synthesis engine idempotent with secret redaction and diff cap
statement: A synthesis engine merges a task intent.md, the per-session trace shards, the step task-name code comments, and the final git diff into step SRS under docs/spec/steps/TaskName/, is idempotent (a no-op when the step directory already exists), caps diff size, and redacts recognized secret patterns and gitignored paths so credentials do not reach the committed SRS.
ac: Synthesis writes step SRS under docs/spec/steps/TaskName/ from intent.md, trace shards, step comments, and the final diff.
Synthesis is a no-op when the step directory for the task already exists.
Synthesis caps the diff size and excludes gitignored paths.
Synthesis redacts recognized secret patterns from its inputs before writing SRS.
depends_on_titles: promote_step_requirement mutation with reservation uniqueness verbatim insert
diff_steps four-way classification keyed on semanticSha
vibe step REQ-ID reservation minter and unreserved-id rejection guard
vibe merge contradiction hard-gate distinguishing synthesized from contradiction-verified

title: vibe step REQ-ID reservation minter and unreserved-id rejection guard
statement: Vibe synthesis mints step requirement IDs only through a tool-governed reservation over the view of HEAD, step, and reserved IDs, never by free-text selection, and promote_step_requirement rejects any ID not produced by the reservation minter.
ac: Synthesized step requirement IDs are produced only by the reservation minter over HEAD, step, and reserved IDs.
The synthesis skill never assigns a literal requirement ID itself.
promote_step_requirement rejects an ID not produced by the reservation minter.
depends_on_titles: promote_step_requirement mutation with reservation uniqueness verbatim insert

title: vibe merge contradiction hard-gate distinguishing synthesized from contradiction-verified
statement: Vibe synthesis and merge enforce a vibe-only hard-gate that distinguishes a synthesized step (step directory exists) from a contradiction-verified one, requiring list_dirty_edges over the touched closure to be empty or explicitly acknowledged before the step is marked complete, while the existing STEP namespace diagnostics remain advisory for non-vibe flows.
ac: A vibe step is not marked complete while list_dirty_edges over its touched closure is non-empty and unacknowledged.
Step-directory existence alone does not satisfy the contradiction-verified condition.
Explicit acknowledgement of remaining dirty edges allows completion.
Non-vibe STEP namespace diagnostics remain advisory and are unaffected by this gate.
depends_on_titles: list_dirty_edges read path with clean whitelist gate
compareReqId raw-byte ordering and computeBlastRadius closure utility

title: set_work_mode and get_work_mode MCP tools
statement: The MCP server registers set_work_mode and get_work_mode tools with zod schemas that forward to the work-mode core, where set_work_mode switches Mode among sdd, vibe, wait and get_work_mode returns the current Mode and Active Task.
ac: get_work_mode returns the current Mode and, for vibe, the Active Task.
set_work_mode switches Mode to a value in sdd, vibe, wait.
Both tools are registered with zod schemas forwarding to the work-mode core.
depends_on_titles: Work mode model with get and set and fail-open default

title: start_vibe_task MCP tool with intent-first ordering and task-name or auto-derive
statement: The MCP start_vibe_task tool captures a task name or derives a slug from the supplied intent when auto is requested, writes the task intent.md first and only then sets Mode=vibe and Active Task, guaranteeing intent-first ordering so a crash cannot leave an Active Task without an intent.md.
ac: start_vibe_task writes intent.md before setting Active Task.
start_vibe_task accepts an explicit task name or derives a slug from the intent when auto is requested.
On completion Mode is vibe and Active Task equals the task name.
A duplicate task name is disambiguated with a suffix.
depends_on_titles: Work mode model with get and set and fail-open default

title: speckiwi init hook-install extension
statement: The speckiwi init command is extended to perform the hook installation (Claude settings merge, Codex hooks.json with version gate, git pre-commit, docs/.kiwi scaffold, and minimal state.md), reporting created, updated, skipped, and warned paths and any clobber or enterprise-suppression warnings.
ac: speckiwi init installs the Claude, Codex, and git hooks and the docs/.kiwi scaffold.
speckiwi init reports created, updated, skipped, and warned paths.
speckiwi init surfaces clobber and enterprise-suppression warnings in its output.

title: speckiwi mode command
statement: The CLI exposes speckiwi mode with an optional sdd, vibe, or wait argument to read or switch the work mode, printing the current Mode and Active Task and rejecting an invalid mode value with a non-zero exit code.
ac: speckiwi mode with no argument prints the current Mode and Active Task.
speckiwi mode with a value switches Mode to a value in sdd, vibe, wait.
speckiwi mode rejects an invalid mode value with a non-zero exit code.
depends_on_titles: Work mode model with get and set and fail-open default

title: speckiwi vibe-gate check CI subcommand
statement: The CLI exposes speckiwi vibe-gate with a check option which exits non-zero when Mode is vibe and an Active Task is set without a corresponding synthesized step directory, intended for wiring into a remote required status check so that unsynthesized vibe commits are blocked where local hooks can be bypassed.
ac: speckiwi vibe-gate check exits non-zero for a vibe Active Task with no synthesized step directory.
speckiwi vibe-gate check exits zero when no unsynthesized vibe task exists.
The command is documented for use as a remote required status check.

title: Mode-conditional governance snippet with AGENT_INSTRUCTION_VERSION bump

ac: The rendered snippet states the SRS MUST rules apply in sdd mode and delegates vibe to Work-Modes-Rules.

ac: docs/rule/Work-Modes-Rules-v1.0.0.md defines sdd, vibe, wait and the vibe intent-first obligation.
The rule doc defines the task-name question with auto-derivation and the step task-name comment convention.

ac: kiwi-vibe asks for the intent and the task name or auto-derives the name from the intent.
kiwi-vibe calls start_vibe_task so intent.md is written before Active Task is set.

kiwi-vibe-commit is a no-op when the task is already synthesized.

statement: A code comment trace-tag convention requires sdd-mode changes to carry the SRS REQ-ID in a comment and vibe-mode changes to carry a step task-name tag since no REQ exists yet, inserted by the coding skills, so synthesis can attribute code regions to a task.
ac: sdd-mode code comments carry the SRS REQ-ID.
vibe-mode code comments carry the step task-name tag.
